title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode8 Much More To Come

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The ceremony's over! I'm kinda tired after keeping my posture that whole time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, when I thought about how our first year ends today, I felt so many emotions well up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Definitely... And when you realize it's also the last time we'll all be together as a class, it feels pretty sad.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But it's not like we'll never be able to see each other again.
I hope we can all stay close in the new school year.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I have something to do with Minori and the others, so I'll be heading out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We agreed to meet up on the roof after the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll see you two later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How about we head to practice ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ichi!
There's something I wanna do, so you go ahead first!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah, Haruka.
Can we talk now? You're not in the middle of a stream or...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're fine!
We're just here to go over our schedule for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well... There's something I want to give you all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
I finally finished my album the other day, and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was thinking, it's thanks to all the people around me that I was able to make enough memories this year to fill up an album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you for that and for helping me with my list, so I brought gifts!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, what a cute envelope. There's a penguin drawn on it...! May I open it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, there are pictures and...a letter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yep! For the photos, I narrowed down the best Haruka shots!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And in the letter, I wrote a bit about my memories of when each picture was taken. Like about the stuff that happened or how much fun I had!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, you really did...
There's a bunch of stuff here, like about the time we traded lunch items and the challenge video we did...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's such a wonderful gift.
It should let you look back on your memories with Saki anytime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah... And it also makes me happy to know that Saki treasures the memories she's made with me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I got to thinking while I was putting my album together. I made lots of memories this year, but that's not all...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm also a part of all of your memories.
Realizing that made me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I decided on this gift. To tell you all that you're also a part of my memories, and to thank you for making them fun ones!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki.
I'll use these photos in my album.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have one of these for each of you! I hope you like them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, I can't wait to see what pictures are in mine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm also a part of Saki's memories, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe... I'll have to finish my album soon too.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, there's something I want to give you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is my thanks for dodgeball the other day. Please accept it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I found this picture when I was putting a photo album together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I love how you're smiling here with Emu about winning the game!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I hoped this could stick with you as a fun memory too, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Tenma...
I'll treasure it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! Pictures from the chocolate fondue party!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... You also decorated the food with a chocolate pen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Airi is super good at decorating stuff... Oh, she also drew the cat on my strawberry there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
She makes reeeally cute cats☆
Oh, these pictures here are from the Seaside School!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We ran into some trouble with our presentation, but it was still fun. The three of us and Honami put on that musical...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And also, we swam out in the ocean and looked for seashells too! I wanna go with you guys again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for the pictures and the letter, Saki. I'll treasure them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Phew. I'm glad I was able to give everyone their gifts before they went home!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wooow!
So many pictures of us with Sakki!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... This one's from the time we stargazed up on the roof. Honami taught us about the stars as if we were at a planetarium.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's some from that after-party we had following one of your shows too. Hehe, this is quite nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki.
It was nice of you to bring pictures and letters for us too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course I did!
The time I've spent with you guys is another really, reeeally important treasure for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for always being there by my side, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, Saki.
Actually, we also have a present for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “You have completed every item on the list of things you wanted to do, and made a great many memories with your friends.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “We salute you on the enthusiasm with which you have rejoiced in your youth.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Let's continue to make more memories together. Signed, your childhood friends who love you very much.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We made this certificate to commemorate you getting through your list.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku and the others helped us with the design.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You must be glad...
You were able to accomplish everything you wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I did sooo much stuff this year that I'd always wanted to do, and I made lots of memories with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (On top of that, I managed to make a really great photo album.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But, this isn't the end at all...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Spending all this time with everyone... I've come up with a whole lot of other things I want to do.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wanna keep accomplishing all that stuff and make more fun memories.)
